About

A Nigerien company serving the national gold sector.

SGCI — Société Générale de Commerce et de l'Industrie SARLU is a mining company under Nigerien law, engaged in the extraction and beneficiation of gold at the AMZEGUER site, in the Agadez region.

Structured under OHADA law and holding valid mining permits, SGCI runs an operation that is already in production, with a clear ambition: to expand its production capacity responsibly, securely and in line with industry standards.

The company relies on an experienced field team, an intimate knowledge of the Aïr massif and a strong commitment to local communities and the Nigerien State.
